condition: isoWeek(n) keeps the current weekday and uses the ISO week-year, so dates before the first ISO week of a year (e.g. 2021-01-01) land in the previous year. This is correct ISO behaviour, not a defect.
workaround: Start from a Monday, or call startOf('isoWeek') after setting the week. To get UTC week numbers, use dayjs.utc.
